title: Body Record
description: One row of a body window's body.jsonl. docs/BODY_SEGMENTS.md is the contract.

id.description: Stable across re-imports. A changed value keeps its id.

source.description: The source family, such as apple_health.

type.description: The source's own identifier for this kind.

by.description: The source's own name for the app or device that recorded this.

at.description: A point reading's exact time, as the source wrote it, with its offset.

start.description: An interval's exact start. On an experience_tile, the whole experience's.

end.description: An interval's exact end. On an experience_tile, the whole experience's.

date.description: The date a dated assertion covers. A dated row has no time.

assembled.description: The rule an experience the source didn't report as one was assembled by, in words.

of.description: The id of the experience this row belongs to.

fields.description: Every other field the source gave. Read by agents, never indexed.

values.description: Values the source's reader restated for search.

words.description: The owner's own words on this record.

x-journal-contract.write_discipline: one file per window, replaced whole and atomically under the source's import lock; rows sorted by time then id; a re-import replaces by id and keeps the rest
